RESUBMISSION: Proposal Enhancement Following Feedback
We are resubmitting our proposal in response to the feedback received on our initial submission. Areas of improvement:
・Optimization: We have outlined several reasons why we believe AGORA is currently inefficient.
・Approach: We have added detailed methodology regarding the development of the User Interface (UI) and the process of gathering user feedback:
・Comparison Clarification: We have clarified the comparison between the two versions that were previously screenshotted.
・Added README File: We have included the requested README file to facilitate better understanding and integration:
・NPM Test and Document Links: We have added the NPM test to ensure consistent and reliable performance. Additionally, we have fixed the document links to enhance clarity and accessibility.
